proof_body:
by
  intro u c w R hu huc h0 hw
  have hR : 0 < R := Metric.pos_of_mem_ball hw
  have hwn : ‖w - c‖ < R := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hw
  have hA : 0 < R + ‖w - c‖ := by positivity
  have hB : 0 < R - ‖w - c‖ := by linarith
  have h : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicContOnCl u (Metric.ball c R) := ⟨hu, by rwa [closure_ball c hR.ne']⟩
  have hP := h.circleAverage_poissonKernel_smul hw
  have hmean : Real.circleAverage u c R = u c := by
    have h' : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicContOnCl u (Metric.ball c |R|) := by rwa [abs_of_pos hR]
    exact HarmonicContOnCl.circleAverage_eq h'
  have hsph : Metric.sphere c |R| = Metric.sphere c R := by rw [abs_of_pos hR]
  have huS : ContinuousOn u (Metric.sphere c R) := huc.mono Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall
  have hwne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, (z - c) - (w - c) ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz he
    have h1 : z = w := by
      have : z - w = 0 := by rw [← he]; ring
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
    subst h1
    have := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    linarith
  have hPc : ContinuousOn (poissonKernel c w) (Metric.sphere c R) := by
    unfold poissonKernel
    refine ContinuousOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) ?_
    intro z hz
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hwne z hz))
  have hiP : CircleIntegrable (poissonKernel c w • u) c R := ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR.le (hPc.smul huS)
  have hiU : CircleIntegrable u c R := huS.circleIntegrable hR.le
  have hbounds : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, (R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖) ≤ poissonKernel c w z ∧ poissonKernel c w z ≤ (R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, herglotzRieszKernel_def]
    exact ⟨le_re_herglotzRieszKernel hz hw, re_herglotzRieszKernel_le hz hw⟩
  constructor
  · rw [← hP, ← hmean]
    have e : ((R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖)) * Real.circleAverage u c R = Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖)) • u z) c R := by
      rw [Real.circleAverage_fun_smul]; rfl
    rw [e]
    apply Real.circleAverage_mono (hiU.const_fun_smul) hiP
    intro x hx
    rw [hsph] at hx
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply', smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbounds x hx).1 (h0 x (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hx))
  · rw [← hP, ← hmean]
    have e : ((R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖)) * Real.circleAverage u c R = Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖)) • u z) c R := by
      rw [Real.circleAverage_fun_smul]; rfl
    rw [e]
    apply Real.circleAverage_mono hiP (hiU.const_fun_smul)
    intro x hx
    rw [hsph] at hx
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply', smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbounds x hx).2 (h0 x (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hx))
target_source: ∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c w : ℂ) (R : ℝ), InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.ball c R) → ContinuousOn u (Metric.closedBall c R) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, 0 ≤ u z) → w ∈ Metric.ball c R → (R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖) * u c ≤ u w ∧ u w ≤ (R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖) * u c
